implementation.targetScope: The root motion-utils utility exports: easing/Bezier curves, scalar and array helpers, memo/pipe, diagnostics, shared configuration and SubscriptionManager. Verified beneath unchanged current14 and application12 Motion callers. Motion renderer, gesture/layout engine and React components are not implemented by this leaf.

changes: No upstream runtime ships; no runtime dependencies.
Safeguarded polynomial inversion is checked against analytical curves and current14; older12 outputs differ slightly.
Subscriptions retain unaffected listeners when a callback removes itself and protect new registrations from stale disposers.
Invalid Bezier controls and step counts reject explicitly in production as well as development.

caller.scope: Fade/transform animation and Motion value subscriptions beneath motion/react. Built foundation only; application adoption not claimed.
